Sano provides the highest protein profile in the most calorie-dense formula found around the globe. Just look at the quality nutritional statistics, each 280-gram serving of Sano Mass provides an avalanche of 1,050 calories, 192-grams of carbs and 56-grams of protein blend that when combined with your normal diet, will help you increase your weight and boost muscle gain. 2.27kg = 16 servings 140g = 1 serving Ingredients Ingredients: Carbo Blend (Maltodextrin, Waxy Maize [CORN] Starch, BARLEY Starch, Sweet Potato, Rolled OAT), Sano Mass Pro-Matrix (WHEY Protein Concentrate, Hydrolyzed WHEY Protein, WHEY Protein Isolate, Micellar CASEIN Protein, MILK Protein Concentrate, MILK Protein Isolate), Lipid Foods Blend (Fractionated COCONUT [MCT] Oil, Avocado, Flax Seed, Pumpkin Seed, Sunflower Oil), Thickeners (Defatted SOYBEAN, Pea, Guar Gum). Natural & Artificial Flavors, Potassium Citrate, Sucralose, Sunflower Lecithin, Enzymes (Lactase, Protease), Cinnamon Extract (Cinnulin PF®), Tart Cherry. For allergens, see ingredients in uppercase.
